nodes.description: SIN3A is the scaffold of a corepressor complex containing HDAC1 and HDAC2 that is recruited by sequence-specific repressors and by the methyl-CpG binding protein MeCP2, linking DNA methylation to histone deacetylation and transcriptional repression. Reduced SIN3A function is expected to weaken repression at its target genes. Mouse embryos lacking Sin3a entirely die around implantation, so the patient state is a partial loss of an essential regulator.
